operator_visible_outcome: URL-reference protocol has one final operation-owned path and the obsolete package path is rejected

inputs.validation: Bounded tracked paths, Go modules, packages, imports and architecture policy

outputs.validation: Deterministic acceptance or rejection with a bounded diagnostic

canonical_state: The three-file URL-reference protocol inventory moves once to internal/operation/urlreference/protocol
derived_state: Updated Product imports, architecture verdict and independent Assurance verdict

authorities.grant: Accept only the final operation-owned protocol package and declared dependency direction
authorities.refusal: Reject the retired URL-reference package or a protocol package outside an operation

authorities.grant: Independently enforce the final protocol path and dependency direction
authorities.refusal: Reject a weaker Production policy or recreated retired path

trust_boundaries.treatment: Compare the tracked tree and Go imports with the final architecture policy
Compare bounded Production policy data with independently compiled final-path rules

resources.acquisition: Read one bounded NUL-delimited tracked-file inventory
resources.bound: At most 100000 paths, 16777216 aggregate source bytes and 30000 milliseconds
resources.release: Release inventory and parsed syntax when policy evaluation returns
resources.cleanup_failure: Return an infrastructure error without accepting the tree

resources.acquisition: Read one bounded strict architecture policy document
resources.bound: At most 1048576 bytes and the declared four migration entries
resources.release: Release decoded policy when independent evaluation returns
resources.cleanup_failure: Return an assurance error without accepting the tree

platforms.evidence: Native Production and Assurance policy execution

invariants.statement: A protocol package exists only beneath its owning operation
invariants.boundary: Go package import to authority owner
invariants.falsifier: A protocol package outside internal/operation passes policy
invariants.residual_uncertainty: Dynamic loading is outside this static import boundary

invariants.statement: The obsolete internal/workerprotocolv1 path is absent and rejected after its move
invariants.boundary: migration tracked path to migration exception
invariants.falsifier: A maintained file recreates the retired path or policy still registers it as a migration root
invariants.residual_uncertainty: The registry is temporary until CEL-STRUCT-005 removes every entry

invariants.statement: The move preserves request and response bytes, strict framing, correlation rules and exit-code coupling
invariants.falsifier: A request, response, diagnostic, status, identity, nonce, hash, limit, deadline or version regression changes
invariants.residual_uncertainty: The deterministic Rust peer remains separately implemented and covered by shared fixtures

success_semantics: Accepted means the final protocol package exists, the old package is absent and protocol bytes and exit codes remain unchanged
refusal_semantics: An outside-operation protocol or retired path returns a bounded rejection
failure_semantics: Malformed policy, parse failure or unavailable required tooling fails the gate
cancellation_semantics: Cancellation stops evaluation and cannot produce acceptance
indeterminate_semantics: Missing or contradictory evidence cannot produce acceptance
recovery_semantics: Rerun from the unchanged tracked inventory; no partial policy result is canonical
compatibility_or_reset_policy: The unused pre-release package is removed outright; no forwarding package, alias, shim or dual implementation is retained
falsifiers: A protocol package outside an operation passes policy
The retired package path is recreated without rejection
Protocol bytes, framing, status or exit-code coupling changes
residual_limitations: This path-only move does not establish new protocol correctness
The Rust worker remains independently implemented and checked against shared protocol fixtures
Exact-pair sign-off requires committed clean Product and Assurance candidates
non_goals: Change protocol bytes, framing, validation, status or exit-code coupling
Create a forwarding package, alias, shim or dual implementation
Change transformation, admission, persistence, supervision or worker behaviour
deletion_criteria: Delete this slice contract only when a later reviewed contract explicitly supersedes its final-path rule
